game_concept: A strategy race set in Shadow Cave – Spider Den, a webbed spider den: the shadow ranger must handle rock golems while practicing control flow: while loops. Core idea – Accumulator Pump: Add values each pass until the running total reaches the goal.
theme: Shadow Cave – Spider Den: a webbed spider den
core_gameplay_loop: In Spider Den, repeat each round: Add values each pass until the running total reaches the goal. Each round the rival advances, and solving the step moves the shadow ranger ahead. Then check the total value and advance.
secondary_mechanics: Hint tokens that reveal one line of code
player_objective: Beat a rival AI to the stone seal by solving code steps involving total that move the shadow ranger forward.
controls: Code-editor: type or edit short lines in the code panel and press Run; click to select targets.
win_condition: Player progress reaches 100% before the rival does (rival speed 0.85).
lose_condition: The rival reaches the stone seal first, or lives reach 0.
learning_alignment: Week 4 – Control Flow: While Loops | Level 8 (extended tier): Accumulator Pump
assets_style: dark pixel-art cavern: torchlit stone, mossy rock, deep shadows, glowing crystals; flat Kenney-style sprites; echoing drips, low drones and torch crackle
duplicate_check_notes: Unique combination of primary mechanic 'Accumulator Pump' (Week 4 slot 6), mission type 'Rival Race', and setting 'Spider Den'. No other file shares this combination; games sharing the mechanic differ in mission/win condition and setting, and games sharing the setting use a different mechanic.

region.name: Shadow Cave
region.mood: echoing drips, low drones and torch crackle

tutorial: Step 1: Look at the code panel. It shows how total changes.
Step 2: Use the controls to apply the code idea against rock golems in Spider Den.
Step 3: Win by meeting the goal: Player progress reaches 100% before the rival does (rival speed 0.85).
